effective.basis: TCG release of the Duelist League 17 participation cards (DL17-EN016), the printing carrying the current text

transitions.historical_text: Add 1 Equip Spell Card from your Graveyard to your hand. You cannot activate that Equip Spell Card this turn.
transitions.modern_text: Target 1 Equip Spell Card in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand. That Equip Spell Card cannot be activated this turn.
transitions.summary: Problem-Solving Card Text rewording only. v0 (DCR-040) 'Select 1 Equip Spell Card from your Graveyard and add it to your hand' and v2 'Target 1 Equip Spell Card in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand' are the standard select-to-target modernisation with the same targeting - official/c20188127.lua carries EFFECT_FLAG_CARD_TARGET - and 'You cannot activate that Equip Spell Card this turn' becoming 'That Equip Spell Card cannot be activated this turn' restates one restriction, implemented as an EFFECT_CANNOT_TRIGGER registered on the retrieved card.

review.notes: The text in force for both GOAT (2005-04-01) and Edison (2010-04-24) is v1 (DR1-EN202, 2005-03-19), a compressed Dark Revelation reprint that drops the selection verb entirely ('Add 1 Equip Spell Card from your Graveyard to your hand'). Read on its own that wording could be taken as non-targeting, which would matter if an opposing effect could remove the chosen Equip Spell from the Graveyard in response; the printing before it says 'Select' and the printing after it says 'Target', and nothing in the packet records an era ruling treating the DR1 wording as a de-targeting, so it is recorded as a printing artifact and the change is cosmetic. This card has no upstream historical or unofficial variant of any kind.
